description: Full details for a single artwork — title, artist, date, medium, dimensions, credit line, place of origin, department, provenance, exhibition history, high-res IIIF image URL. Use artwork ID from search results (ARTIC)

id.description: ARTIC artwork ID from search results (e.g. 16568 for Monet Water Lilies)

name: culture.artic.artwork

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Artwork Details (ARTIC)
